name: hearer
description: Self-hosted music request and upload portal.

scripts.e2e: pnpm --filter server --filter web build && pnpm --filter e2e e2e
scripts.dev: mkdir -p .dev/data .dev/music .dev/staging && NODE_ENV=development LOG_FORMAT=pretty DATA_DIR=${DATA_DIR:-$PWD/.dev/data} MUSIC_DIR=${MUSIC_DIR:-$PWD/.dev/music} STAGING_DIR=${STAGING_DIR:-$PWD/.dev/staging} concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "pnpm --filter server dev" "pnpm --filter web dev"
